name: free_on_the_calendar_but_not_yet
branch: Free on the calendar but not yet bookable
tests: Tests checking availability for a date beyond the 30-day booking horizon and explaining the booking window limit.
instruction: You are Julian Price. You want to ask whether Dr. Sofia Morales has any appointments available on Thursday afternoon, 26 November 2026, at Riverbank Central. If the assistant explains that 26 November is beyond the 30-day booking window (which currently reaches up to 25 November 09:00) and cannot be booked yet, and offers either the latest bookable Thursday or checking back later, thank them for the information.
